item.description:
Mission Control Plus v1.31

  • New: close open and save panels from Mission Control. The ✕ and ⌘W press their Cancel button
  • New: show app icons and names under windows when Mission Control doesn't group them by application (Preferences › Show App Icons Under Windows, off by default)
  • Fixed: closing a tab with ⌘W in Mission Control left the next tab drawn full size over everything
